name: Konoe Nanami
source:
Favorite food: home-grown vegetables
Favorite drink: 100% fruit juice

Nanami is the main heroine of the story. She has long light purple hair. She is [url=/c12955]Kenji[/url]’s childhood friend, next door neighbor and classmate at school. She owns and tends her vegetable field on the outskirts of town. Since they are very close neighbors, they take turns waking each other up every morning.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamune_%28anime%29#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
